slide.title: Cover
slide.notes: Welcome everyone. Today I will show you how to create presentations using Presenter, a C++17 rendering engine that turns XML into beautiful slides.

slide.title: What is Presenter
slide.notes: Presenter reads XML slide definitions and renders them via SDL2. It supports manual layouts with stacks, grids, and borders. Every element is placed explicitly — no hidden auto-formatting.

stack.text: A C++17 presentation renderer that reads XML and outputs to two windows: an audience display and a presenter view with notes.
Stack, grid, and border elements give you full control.
Private notes visible only in the presenter view.
Built-in and custom styles with hotkey switching.

slide.title: Closing
slide.notes: That is the basics. Presenter is open source and available on GitHub. Thank you for your time.
